notes: Interleaved isolated workers. Inbound/outbound include scheduling and structured-clone/transfer; not pure wire time. GC/heap sampling runs are diagnostic, not latency evidence. Worker heap/ArrayBuffer peaks are sampled only in profile mode; RSS is process-wide and includes the retained main-thread oracle. Quantiles are per run, never differences of independent percentiles.
